issues.display_title: Issue #1689: Fix Responsive Header on Mobile
issues.main_description_html:
The mobile header dropdown menu is broken and visually glitches on small screens.

Issues:

  1. The .nav-mobile-menu expands within the document flow and pushes the content below it down, instead of overlaying it.
  2. The .nav-mobile-menu background and backdrop-filter stack on top of the parent .nav's background, resulting in a double-blur effect that looks bad.

Proposed Fixes:

  • Change .nav-mobile-menu to use position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 0; right: 0; width: 100%; z-index: 10; so it overlays content correctly.
  • Add a box-shadow for depth.
  • Fix the backdrop-filter and padding so it renders cleanly and aligns properly on mobile.

issues.display_title: Issue #1690: Responsive dash-shell should not be sticky
issues.main_description_html:
Dash-shell sidebar is sticky on responsive views which prevents scrolling. Need to use position: static for :host in sidemenu.component.scss inside the @media (max-width: 880px) breakpoint so it scrolls with the page content. (Fixed in latest agent session, issue created for tracking).

issues.display_title: Issue #1691: Responsive layout issue in Profile Settings form
issues.main_description_html:
The profile settings form (First name, Last name, Username, Artistic medium, About, Location) has responsive layout issues on smaller screens. Specifically, the 'First name' and 'Last name' side-by-side inputs need to stack or adjust their layout appropriately when the screen width decreases. Ensure proper padding, margin, and stacking of input fields across all viewport sizes.

Additional note: When making the panel full-width on tablet viewports, ensure the layout is also correctly adjusted for responsive mobile viewports.

Repro:
